visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Touching Intervals Are Not Merged
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The intervals [1, 4] and [4, 5] touch at 4 and should merge into [[1, 5]], but the program keeps them apart.

solution.explanation: An interval that starts exactly where the previous one ends still touches it, so the test must include equality (<=). With < the boundary case is treated as a gap.
